com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.domain.sms.PhoneVerification

Packages that use PhoneVerification
Package
Description
com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.application.sms
Use cases of the SMS channel: phone enrolment and verification, cost-capped sending of codes and the enrolment query of the SMS second factor.
com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.domain.sms
Phones and text messages: the phone number value object, the phone a user verified, the ports to send messages, keep phones and pending verifications, record the spend, and the policy that caps the cost.
com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.infrastructure.persistence.sms
PostgreSQL implementations of the SMS ports: the verified phone numbers and the phone verifications in progress (both over the user_phones table) and the SMS cost ledger (over the sms_cost_ledger table).
